history.summary: A 678 sqft 99-year 2BR at LIV @ MB (TOP 2024) in D15 at $1.7M ($2,507 PSF), 350m from Katong Park TE24 MRT. Brand-new and well-located, but the high $2,507 PSF on a leasehold with only ~0.7%/yr resale appreciation and a weak arena profile makes the entry price hard to justify.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely strong location — 350m to Katong Park TEL, prime D15, fresh 2024 development, deep 320-txn data and the widest 2BR tenant pool. But the listed $2,507 PSF is steep for a 99-year leasehold, and the resale-only series shows just ~0.7%/yr — the high median PSF ($2,708) reflects new-launch pricing, not realized appreciation. The low score_1000 (377) and 119-117 record signal poor relative value at this PSF. New + transit-rich keeps it Neutral, but pay-up risk is real.
red_flags: $2,507 PSF on a 99-year leasehold is a rich entry
Resale-only appreciation only ~0.7%/yr — new-launch pricing inflates median
Leasehold clock starts now; freehold competitors nearby
catalysts: 350m to Katong Park TE24 MRT (TEL) — top-tier connectivity
Prime D15 with the deepest 2BR rental demand
